from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,UTC
import json,shutil
from urllib.parse import urlsplit,parse_qs,urlencode,urlunsplit
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright,expect
out=Path('/tmp/orbitiq-phase7');base='http://127.0.0.1:5196';archive=json.loads((out/'archive-context.json').read_text());results=[];profile=out/'browser-profile-v2'
# Only this test-owned profile is created; no user browser or orbital data is touched.
if profile.exists():raise RuntimeError('Use a fresh browser-profile directory for this evidence run')
errors=[];requests=[]
def watch(page):
 page.on('pageerror',lambda e:errors.append(str(e)))
 page.on('request',lambda r:requests.append({'method':r.method,'url':r.url}))
def no_overflow(page):
 assert page.evaluate('document.documentElement.scrollWidth<=innerWidth')
 assert page.evaluate('(()=>{const ids=[...document.querySelectorAll("[id]")].map(e=>e.id);return new Set(ids).size===ids.length})()')
def visible_region(page,name):return page.get_by_role('region',name=name,exact=True)
def save(region,title,note=''):
 region.get_by_label('Investigation title',exact=True).fill(title)
 if note:region.get_by_label('Private local notes (optional)',exact=True).fill(note)
 region.get_by_label('Investigation title',exact=True).press('Enter')
 expect(region.get_by_text(f'Saved “{title}” in this browser. Open Saved investigations to reopen it.',exact=True)).to_be_visible()
def copy(region,page):
 region.get_by_role('button',name='Copy share link',exact=True).click()
 expect(region.get_by_text('Share link copied. Title and private notes were not included.',exact=True)).to_be_visible()
 value=region.get_by_label('Shareable investigation link',exact=True).input_value()
 assert page.evaluate('navigator.clipboard.readText()')==value
 assert len(value)<=2048
 return value
def alter(link,field,value):
 parts=urlsplit(link);params=parse_qs(parts.fragment.split('?',1)[1]);params[field]=[value]
 return urlunsplit((parts.scheme,parts.netloc,parts.path,parts.query,'/investigation?'+urlencode({k:v[0] for k,v in params.items()})))
with sync_playwright() as p:
 context=p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(str(profile),executable_path='/usr/bin/chromium',headless=True,viewport={'width':1440,'height':1000},permissions=['clipboard-read','clipboard-write'],args=['--no-sandbox','--use-angle=swiftshader','--enable-unsafe-swiftshader'])
 version=context.browser.version;page=context.pages[0];watch(page)
 try:
  page.goto(base,wait_until='networkidle');expect(page.get_by_text('Backend connected',exact=True)).to_be_visible()
  page.get_by_role('button',name='Discovery & history',exact=True).click()
  page.get_by_label('Name, NORAD ID or international identifier').fill('25544')
  page.get_by_role('button',name='Search stored records',exact=True).click()
  page.get_by_role('button',name='Inspect snapshot #1',exact=True).click()
  detail=visible_region(page,'Snapshot #1: fixed source detail');expect(detail).to_be_visible()
  actions=detail.get_by_role('region',name='Save or share snapshot investigation',exact=True)
  save(actions,'ISS source','Snapshot note stays local')
  source_link=copy(actions,page);assert 'Snapshot+note' not in source_link and 'ISS+source' not in source_link
  page.get_by_role('button',name='Saved investigations',exact=True).click()
  expect(page.get_by_role('heading',name='ISS source',exact=True)).to_be_visible();assert page.url.endswith('#/saved')
  page.get_by_role('button',name='Discovery & history',exact=True).click()
  expect(detail).to_be_visible();detail.get_by_role('button',name='Open exact source in 3D explorer',exact=True).click()
  track=visible_region(page,'Earth-relative ground track')
  track.get_by_label('Duration (minutes)',exact=True).fill('2');track.get_by_label('Sample step (seconds)',exact=True).fill('60')
  track.get_by_role('button',name='Generate ground track',exact=True).click()
  expect(track.get_by_text('3 calculated samples · TEME → ITRS → WGS84',exact=True)).to_be_visible()
  track.get_by_role('button',name='Next sample',exact=True).click();expect(track.get_by_label('Selected track sample',exact=True)).to_have_value('1')
  actions=track.get_by_role('region',name='Save or share ground-track investigation',exact=True)
  save(actions,'ISS track','Track note stays local');track_link=copy(actions,page)
  assert parse_qs(urlsplit(track_link).fragment.split('?',1)[1])['selected_index']==['1']
  assert 'Track+note' not in track_link
  page.screenshot(path=str(out/'desktop-track-save.png'),full_page=True);no_overflow(page)
  page.get_by_role('button',name='Saved investigations',exact=True).click()
  page.get_by_role('button',name='Open ISS track',exact=True).click()
  restored=visible_region(page,'Reopened investigation');expect(restored.get_by_label('Selected track sample',exact=True)).to_have_value('1')
  expect(restored.get_by_label('Duration (minutes)',exact=True)).to_have_value('2')
  page.reload(wait_until='networkidle');shared=visible_region(page,'Shared investigation · read-only inputs')
  expect(shared.get_by_label('Selected track sample',exact=True)).to_have_value('1')
  expect(shared.get_by_label('Duration (minutes)',exact=True)).to_be_disabled()
  expect(shared.get_by_role('button',name='Save in this browser',exact=True)).to_have_count(0)
  page.get_by_role('button',name='Explore an editable copy',exact=True).click();restored=visible_region(page,'Reopened investigation')
  expect(restored.get_by_label('Duration (minutes)',exact=True)).to_be_enabled()
  assert len(page.evaluate('JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("orbitiq.saved-investigations.v1")).records'))==2
  page.get_by_role('button',name='Discovery & history',exact=True).click()
  page.get_by_label('Name, NORAD ID or international identifier').fill('25544');page.get_by_role('button',name='Search stored records',exact=True).click()
  page.get_by_role('button',name='Use #1 as A',exact=True).click();page.get_by_role('button',name='Use #2 as B',exact=True).click();page.get_by_role('button',name='Compare snapshots',exact=True).click()
  page.get_by_label('Common evaluation time (optional, explicit timezone)',exact=True).fill(archive['common_at']);page.get_by_label('State frame').select_option('ITRS');page.get_by_role('button',name='Compare selected snapshots',exact=True).click()
  expect(page.get_by_role('heading',name='Common-time calculated states · ITRS',exact=True)).to_be_visible()
  actions=visible_region(page,'Save or share comparison investigation');save(actions,'ISS comparison');comparison_link=copy(actions,page)
  page.get_by_role('button',name='Saved investigations',exact=True).click();page.get_by_role('button',name='Edit ISS comparison',exact=True).click()
  page.get_by_label('Saved title',exact=True).fill('ISS comparison renamed');page.get_by_label('Saved coordinate frame').select_option('TEME');page.get_by_role('button',name='Save changes',exact=True).click()
  expect(page.get_by_role('heading',name='ISS comparison renamed',exact=True)).to_be_visible()
  page.get_by_role('button',name='Open ISS comparison renamed',exact=True).click();restored=visible_region(page,'Reopened investigation')
  expect(restored.get_by_role('heading',name='Common-time calculated states · TEME',exact=True)).to_be_visible()
  expect(restored.get_by_label('Snapshot A',exact=True)).to_have_value('1');expect(restored.get_by_label('Snapshot B',exact=True)).to_have_value('2')
  page.get_by_role('button',name='Saved investigations',exact=True).click();page.get_by_role('button',name='Delete ISS source',exact=True).click();page.get_by_role('button',name='Keep investigation',exact=True).click()
  expect(page.get_by_role('heading',name='ISS source',exact=True)).to_be_visible()
  page.get_by_role('button',name='Delete ISS source',exact=True).click();page.get_by_role('button',name='Confirm local deletion',exact=True).click();expect(page.get_by_role('heading',name='ISS source',exact=True)).to_have_count(0)
  records_before=page.evaluate('JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("orbitiq.saved-investigations.v1")).records');assert len(records_before)==2
  page.screenshot(path=str(out/'desktop-saved-list.png'),full_page=True);no_overflow(page)
  results.append({'flow':'desktop save/reopen/update/share/delete','status':'PASS','viewport':[1440,1000],'keyboard_enter_save':True,'clipboard_real_readback':True,'discovery_context_retained':True,'exact_snapshot':1,'track_selected_sample':1,'refresh_reconstructs_read_only_link':True,'editable_copy_requires_explicit_action':True,'comparison_sources':[1,2],'comparison_frame_edit_restored':'TEME','local_deletion_confirmed':True,'horizontal_overflow':False})
  (out/'links.json').write_text(json.dumps({'snapshot':source_link,'track':track_link,'comparison':comparison_link},indent=2)+'\n')
 finally:context.close()
 # Real browser-process restart, using the test-owned persistent profile.
 restarted=p.chromium.launch_persistent_context(str(profile),executable_path='/usr/bin/chromium',headless=True,viewport={'width':1440,'height':1000},args=['--no-sandbox','--use-angle=swiftshader','--enable-unsafe-swiftshader'])
 page=restarted.pages[0];watch(page);page.goto(base+'/#/saved',wait_until='networkidle')
 expect(page.get_by_role('heading',name='ISS track',exact=True)).to_be_visible();expect(page.get_by_role('heading',name='ISS comparison renamed',exact=True)).to_be_visible()
 records_after=page.evaluate('JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem("orbitiq.saved-investigations.v1")).records');assert records_before==records_after
 results.append({'flow':'browser-process restart','status':'PASS','same_local_records_after_restart':True,'record_count':2});restarted.close()
 browser=p.chromium.launch(executable_path='/usr/bin/chromium',headless=True,args=['--no-sandbox','--use-angle=swiftshader','--enable-unsafe-swiftshader'])
 for width,height,link,mode in [(820,1180,track_link,'ground-track'),(390,844,comparison_link,'comparison'),(390,844,source_link,'snapshot')]:
  c=browser.new_context(viewport={'width':width,'height':height});page=c.new_page();watch(page);page.goto(link,wait_until='networkidle');shared=visible_region(page,'Shared investigation · read-only inputs')
  expect(shared.get_by_text('Investigation inputs restored:',exact=False)).to_be_visible()
  if mode=='ground-track':expect(shared.get_by_label('Selected track sample',exact=True)).to_have_value('1');expect(shared.get_by_label('Duration (minutes)',exact=True)).to_be_disabled()
  if mode=='comparison':expect(shared.get_by_role('heading',name='Common-time calculated states · ITRS',exact=True)).to_be_visible();expect(shared.get_by_label('State frame')).to_be_disabled()
  if mode=='snapshot':expect(shared.get_by_label('Saved snapshot')).to_be_disabled()
  assert page.evaluate('localStorage.getItem("orbitiq.saved-investigations.v1")') is None
  assert not page.get_by_role('button',name='Save in this browser',exact=True).count();no_overflow(page)
  page.screenshot(path=str(out/f'shared-{mode}-{width}.png'),full_page=True)
  results.append({'flow':'fresh recipient','mode':mode,'status':'PASS','viewport':[width,height],'no_local_saves_imported':True,'read_only_inputs':True,'horizontal_overflow':False});c.close()
 for kind,link,expected in [('missing-snapshot',alter(source_link,'snapshot','99999'),'missing from this archive'),('wrong-satellite',alter(source_link,'catalog','12345'),'does not match the saved satellite'),('unsupported-version',alter(source_link,'v','2'),'Unsupported investigation link version'),('oversized',source_link+'x'*2048,'too long')]:
  c=browser.new_context();page=c.new_page();watch(page);start=len(requests);page.goto(link,wait_until='networkidle');expect(page.get_by_role('alert')).to_contain_text(expected)
  own=requests[start:];assert all(r['method']=='GET' for r in own)
  if kind in ['unsupported-version','oversized']:assert all('/api/snapshots' not in r['url'] for r in own)
  results.append({'flow':kind,'status':'PASS','message_checked':expected,'requests':own});c.close()

 assert not errors,errors
 assert all(r['method']=='GET' for r in requests)
 external=[r for r in requests if not r['url'].startswith(base)];assert not external,external
 report={'status':'PASS','at':datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),'browser':version,'real_browser_api_and_webgl':True,'mocked_api':False,'mocked_canvas':False,'data_kind':'existing genuine GP snapshots, not observations','flows':results,'page_errors':errors,'external_requests':external,'requests':requests,'local_records':records_after,'share_links':{'snapshot':source_link,'track':track_link,'comparison':comparison_link}}

import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,UTC
from urllib.parse import urlsplit,parse_qs,urlencode,urlunsplit
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright,expect
out=Path('/tmp/orbitiq-phase7');links=json.loads((out/'links.json').read_text());mode=sys.argv[1];rows=[];errors=[];responses=[]
with sync_playwright() as p:
 browser=p.chromium.launch(executable_path='/usr/bin/chromium',headless=True,args=['--no-sandbox','--use-angle=swiftshader','--enable-unsafe-swiftshader'])
 if mode=='normal':
  for width,height in [(1440,1000),(820,1180),(390,844)]:

browser_checks.artifact_retention: Temporary local artifacts; runner sources embedded here; no browser profile is shipped. Reruns require actual archive and local services; use a new test-owned profile.

fixture_scope: Backend/frontend automated tests use isolated fixtures/mocks and temporary databases; no fixtures were inserted into normal archive. Scientific fixtures are numerical references, not observations. Browser workflows use genuine existing stored ISS records.

resolved_failures_and_findings.cause: One newly added restoration test file had unformatted layout.
resolved_failures_and_findings.resolution: Applied Prettier to that file; final full formatting and frontend suite pass.

resolved_failures_and_findings.cause: Mounted original/restored views could duplicate static heading IDs.
resolved_failures_and_findings.resolution: React useId for explorer/track/discovery/detail/comparison headings; added retained/reopened-region regression and checked unique DOM IDs in browser workflows.

resolved_failures_and_findings.cause: Exact nested select label lookup did not include option text in the actual accessible name.
resolved_failures_and_findings.resolution: Use the existing nonexact label locator, retain value assertions; all nine flows passed twice.

resolved_failures_and_findings.cause: Harness expected the word predicted and status 503; actual existing contract is measured-data requirement and 422 eop_prediction_disallowed.
resolved_failures_and_findings.resolution: Checked production policy implementation, asserted its actual error/status and absence of track samples; succeeded without policy changes.

resolved_failures_and_findings.cause: Initial fixture timestamp was timezone-naive; server correctly refused it.
resolved_failures_and_findings.resolution: Marked isolated fixture time UTC; all seven tests pass without relaxing API validation.

resolved_failures_and_findings.cause: Global Python lacked project sgp4 dependency.
resolved_failures_and_findings.resolution: Repeated fingerprint check using uv run --locked and project dependencies; unchanged database verified.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing architecture and persistence capabilities inspected
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Existing React navigation, read-only API, schema-3 archive, CLI-only ingestion and absence of auth inspected; baseline recorded.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Versioned investigation schema documented and validated
acceptance_criteria.evidence: saved-investigations.md; strict version-1 model, local envelope and URL validators; 68 model/storage tests.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Saved investigations preserve exact snapshot and satellite context
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Both source references bind snapshot/catalog/epoch/retrieval/hash; resolver and genuine archive checks reject differences.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Users can save and reopen supported investigations
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Real browser snapshot, position, track/sample and A/B comparison save/open workflows passed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Persistence guarantees match the implemented storage mechanism
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Validated browser-local writes with exact read-back; reload and actual browser-process restart passed; retention limits disclosed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Shareable links reconstruct the intended investigation
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Actual application fragment route reconstructs all four modes against genuine archive records.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Links contain only bounded, necessary state
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 2048-character URL, known unique mode-specific keys; excludes title/notes/local identity/payloads/numerical results.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Missing historical records are disclosed without silent substitution
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Real browser missing snapshot, wrong catalog and changed hash fail explicitly; exact-ID resolver never searches latest.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Shared investigations are read-only
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Shared definition controls disabled and local mutation controls absent; temporary camera/timeline navigation and explicit editable copy only.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Authentication and authorization follow the existing architecture
acceptance_criteria.evidence: No auth exists; no improvised identity system or anonymous permanent server storage API introduced.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Unsupported claims of cross-device or cloud persistence are avoided
acceptance_criteria.evidence: UI and guide identify browser/origin-local saves and parameter links; recipients import no local records automatically.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: URL state and persisted investigation records are validated
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Strict schema, size/text/identifier/time/frame/count validation, corrupt-store preservation, duplicate/irrelevant-key rejection tested.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Evaluation time, coordinate frame, units, and provenance are preserved where relevant
acceptance_criteria.evidence: UTC microseconds and exact source metadata retained; TEME/ITRS and existing fixed km/km/s, WGS84 conventions displayed; actual selected sample/common time restored.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing propagation and transformation services are reused
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Existing position, ground-track and comparison APIs/components reused; no production backend or scientific algorithm changed.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The application distinguishes restored inputs from guaranteed historical numerical output
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Restored-view notice explicitly describes current-resource recomputation and no stored or guaranteed original numerical outputs.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Local saves and shareable links are clearly distinguished
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Visible browser-local/non-sync labels, read-only link banner, manual clipboard fallback and no auto-import.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Responsive and accessible interactions work
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Chromium desktop/tablet/mobile workflows, keyboard Enter save, labelled native controls and unique retained-view heading IDs checked; scope is not a full accessibility audit.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing snapshots and ingestion audit records remain intact
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Database bytes and full schema/table fingerprints match baseline; all pre-existing reports unchanged.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Applicable security and migration tests pass
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Seven new restoration/read-only backend tests passed in full suite; existing migration/recovery tests passed. No migration or capability-token service applicable.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: New backend and frontend tests pass
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 7 new backend and 95 additional frontend tests passed; full totals 589 backend and 275 frontend.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Existing scientific regression checks pass
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 40 SGP4, 6 terrestrial, 32 expanded comparisons, 28 geodetic components and 28 separate round-trips passed with unchanged fixtures/thresholds.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Lint, formatting, TypeScript, and production build checks pass
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Final Ruff check/format, ESLint, Prettier, tsc and Vite production build exit 0; warning retained.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: No unresolved regression is hidden
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Resolved formatting/a11y issues and harness corrections disclosed; no unresolved defect found in executed scope; limits and warnings remain visible.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Documentation accurately records the implementation and its limitations
acceptance_criteria.evidence: Schema/usage guide, this phase report and command-derived structured evidence distinguish real archive workflows from fixtures and numerical references.

remaining_limitations: Independent observation-based prediction validation remains BLOCKED: zero independent observations used. Orbital prediction uncertainty remains unquantified; regression agreement is not universal real-world accuracy.

Persistence is browser-profile/origin local and plaintext. Clearing storage, eviction, private browsing or profile loss can remove saves; no cloud synchronization, account ownership, application export/import or retention guarantee.

Parameter links require the exact underlying archive records to remain accessible and match hashes/times. The genuine local SQLite archive is ignored by Git and is not distributed by a fresh source checkout.
Sharing has no token secrecy, expiry or revocation. Deleting a local record does not revoke links. Anyone with parameters and archive access can reconstruct them.
Original calculated outputs and EOP versions are not stored. Recomputations use current resources and strict backend limits; original byte-identical results are not guaranteed.
Camera/zoom and playback state are not serialized; selected aligned track sample and sampling parameters are restored. Shared camera/timeline navigation is temporary.
Web Locks serialize cooperating same-origin tabs where available; fallback browsers have no cross-tab atomicity guarantee.
Chromium with software WebGL2 was tested at three viewport sizes; no Safari/Firefox, physical mobile GPU, formal screen-reader/conformance audit, public deployment or remote CI result is claimed.
Existing Vite renderer chunk exceeds 500 kB (558.60 kB minified); existing Starlette/httpx test-client deprecation warning remains. No dependencies changed.
No new authenticated/public-hosting protection is provided. Production hosting, persistent archive deployment and public launch controls remain separate work.
